title: When the Room Sings
author: E. M. Sandoval
blurb: Odile Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
